headline: SURINAME GETS ITS NEXT DISTRICT — Founders Metals Confirms Antino Northeast: 58.5m at 1.00 g/t Au First-Ever Drill; 4-Front 70K-m Campaign Running Hot (TSXV:FDR)
snippet: Founders Metals Inc. (TSXV: FDR) confirmed a new gold discovery at Antino Northeast on July 15, delivering 58.5 metres at 1.00 g/t gold from 18.6 metres in hole ANE009 — including 18.0 metres at 1.59 g/t — from the first-ever drilling of a kilometre-scale gold-in-auger anomaly with 1,200 metres of confirmed strike. Simultaneously, Antino North returned 16.5 metres at 1.82 g/t gold and 8.1 metres at 3.42 g/t gold from surface, while Antino West intersected visible gold in two shear zones with assays pending — all within a fully funded 70,000-metre 2026 program operating across four active fronts in southeastern Suriname.

headline: BABINE PORPHYRY BLASTS OPEN 2026 SEASON — American Eagle NAK26-83: 801m at 0.49% CuEq from 33m, 154m at 1.21% CuEq High-Grade Core; First of 80 Holes with $50M Cash (TSXV:AE)
snippet: American Eagle Gold Corp. (TSXV: AE) released the opening 2026 result at its NAK copper-gold porphyry project in British Columbia's Babine district: hole NAK26-83 returned 154 metres at 1.21% copper equivalent within a broader 280-metre interval at 0.96% CuEq from surface, plus 801 metres at 0.49% CuEq from 33 metres depth, extending the South Zone high-grade core 100 metres north. This is the first of approximately 80 planned holes in a fully funded 50,000+ metre campaign backed by approximately $50 million in cash — the largest drill program in American Eagle's history and one of the largest underway in BC — with a new road and trail network in place to reduce helicopter costs.

headline: OYU TOLGOI COPPER RAMPS +31% YoY AS COSTS HALVE — Rio Tinto Q2: 89Mt Iron Ore Sales, Best H1 Pilbara Since 2018; C1 Guidance Cut to $0.30-0.50/lb (ASX:RIO)
snippet: Rio Tinto's second quarter 2026 production update shows the Oyu Tolgoi underground mine in Mongolia delivering 31% year-on-year copper growth for H1 2026, with copper C1 net unit cost guidance slashed to $0.30-0.50 per pound from the prior $0.65-0.75/lb as the ramp-up accelerates toward its 500,000 tonne per annum steady-state target from 2028 to 2036. Pilbara iron ore posted its strongest H1 since 2018 with 89 million tonnes sold in Q2 (+5% YoY), and the company held its 2026 production guidance unchanged — the Oyu Tolgoi cost improvement directly affects copper supply economics tracked by junior explorers competing for investor capital.

headline: TURMALINA'S FIRST FULL QUARTER FIRES — Jaguar Mining Q2: 13,057 oz Au (+19% YoY), Restarted Brazil Mine 31% of Consolidated Output; H2 Ramp Targets Guidance (TSX:JAG)
snippet: Jaguar Mining Inc. (TSX: JAG) reported 13,057 ounces of gold in Q2 2026 — 19% above the year-ago quarter — marking the first full production quarter following the restart of its Turmalina mine in Brazil, which contributed 3,994 ounces at 2.94 g/t gold from 50,190 tonnes processed and accounted for 31% of consolidated output. The Pilar mine remained steady at 9,063 ounces from 96,020 tonnes at 3.30 g/t with 89% recovery, and the company confirmed it remains on track for full-year guidance as Turmalina's throughput and recovery rates continue to improve through the ramp-up phase.

headline: ERITREA GOLD CAMP DRILLS AGAIN — Alpha Exploration Opens 6,500m Phase 1 at Aburna; Hill 52, Central, Northeast + New Corridor Targets in Fully Funded 2026 Campaign (TSXV:ALEX)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Alpha Exploration Ltd.
snippet: Alpha Exploration Ltd. (TSXV: ALEX) has commenced core and reverse circulation drilling at its Aburna Gold Project in Eritrea, launching a fully funded 6,500-metre Phase 1 campaign targeting shallow gold mineralization already confirmed at the Hill 52, Central and Northeast prospects — including historical intercepts of 15.33 g/t gold over 18 metres. The 2026 program also tests several newly identified high-priority targets within the broader Aburna corridor, extending the exploration footprint beyond previously drilled zones for the first time in this phase.

headline: NEVADA TRIPLE-ZONE REVIVAL: +210% QoQ — Fortitude Gold Q2: 2,133 oz from Pearl Deep, County Line and Scarlet South; Multi-Pit Ramp Continues (OTCQB:FTCO)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Fortitude Gold Corp.
snippet: Fortitude Gold Corp. (OTCQB: FTCO) reported preliminary Q2 2026 gold production of 2,133 ounces — a 210% increase over the prior quarter — drawing simultaneously from three production zones at its Nevada operations: Pearl Deep, County Line, and Scarlet South, supplemented by residual leach. The company targets continued ramp-up across these zones in coming quarters as the multi-pit, heap-leach operation builds toward more consistent quarterly output.

headline: 120 HOLES, 36,000m — Frontier Nuclear Fires Up Wyoming Powder River Basin for Roll-Front Uranium; Maiden MRE Target Early 2027 (Nasdaq:FNUC)
source_name: GlobeNewsWire / Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc.
snippet: Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc. (Nasdaq: FNUC) has launched a 2026 drill program at its Pine Ridge uranium project in Wyoming's Powder River Basin, comprising approximately 120 holes totalling roughly 36,000 metres to be completed with one rig operating July through December 2026. The program targets definition of classic Powder River Basin roll-front uranium deposits amenable to in-situ recovery, with the objective of completing sufficient work to underpin a maiden mineral resource estimate by early 2027.

headline: MINAURUM ORDERS ALAMOS SILVER RESOURCE REFRESH — SGS Adding Europa Sur, Quintera, San Jose Veins to 55Moz AgEq Base; New Estimate Expected H2 2026 (TSXV:MGG)
snippet: Minaurum Silver Inc. (TSXV: MGG) has engaged SGS Metallurgy and Consulting Geological Services to update the mineral resource estimate for its high-grade Alamos Silver Project in Sonora, Mexico, incorporating data from its completed 50,000-metre Phase II drill campaign. The update adds new vein zones — Europa Sur, Quintera, and San Jose — to the core Europa, Promontorio, and Travesia veins already in the existing inferred resource of approximately 55 million ounces of silver equivalent, with the updated estimate expected in the second half of 2026.

headline: ED STEER VIA MONEY METALS: SIX YEARS OF SILVER DEFICIT AND SUPPLY TIGHTENING — 'Triple-Digit Silver Before Year-End Possible if Commercials Step Back'
snippet: In a Money Metals Exchange interview published July 13, veteran precious metals analyst Ed Steer argues that gold and silver are set up for a significant surge: silver has run a structural supply deficit for six consecutive years with annual consumption consistently outpacing mine production, physical inventories are tightening, Eastern demand is growing, and sovereign debt loads worldwide are structurally bullish for hard assets. Steer targets a return to triple-digit silver before the end of 2026 — contingent on commercial traders stepping back from historically large short positions — adding specific timing to a thesis now gaining mainstream traction among precious metals analysts.

headline: CEBOLLETA CORE SHIPS TO HAZEN FOR HEAP-LEACH TESTS — Premier American Uranium Completes 6,030 ft PQ Drill at New Mexico Underground; Column Leach Tests Begin, Updated PEA in 2027
snippet: Premier American Uranium Inc. successfully completed 6,030 feet of PQ-core drilling at its Cebolleta Uranium Project in New Mexico — drilled from the underground resource area to recover representative samples — and delivered all material to Hazen Research in Golden, Colorado. The comprehensive metallurgical testing program includes mineralogical characterization, bottle-roll recovery testing, and long-term column leach tests examining multiple oxidants and lixiviants to optimize heap-leach uranium extraction; results will feed an updated preliminary economic assessment expected in 2027.
